name: agent402-structured-tools
summary: Agent402 tools for use with LangChain in Python (the applied layer of Agentic Finance): turn Agent402's catalog of 500+ pay-per-call tools and skill packs (x402 or MPP) into structured tools for Python agents via four meta-tools. The pure-CPU tools are free via proof-of-work - no wallet, no API keys. Formerly agent402-langchain.
